name: engram
description: Engram (Gentleman-Programming/engram) as a remote BINARY plugin: a single self-contained Go binary (SQLite + FTS5) exposing an MCP stdio server. There is no source build - the plugin INSTALL action downloads the prebuilt artifact published on GitHub Releases for the running platform, verifies its SHA-256, places it (executable) in the plugin directory, and the entrypoint starts the MCP server from it. Use for persistent cross-session memory (mem_save / mem_search / mem_context).
